vectors.scenario: three source-separated active records match one canonical asset/right and pack hashes recompute
pack hash is modified after collection
snapshot evidence hash differs from embedded provider record
registry/custody/representation source identities are mixed or duplicated
one embedded legal right differs from campaign expectation
one snapshot is stale or cross-source skew exceeds policy
one source generation is replayed or regressed
two source classes reuse the same evidence hash
pack claims execution authority, live value, finality or external effects

required_invariants: exactly registry, custody and representation source classes are captured
source generations are positive and checked against previous generations by Sentinel
snapshot evidence and record identities project exactly
all records bind to one canonical asset/right/legal instrument/rights set
pack hash and source-separation digest are independently recomputed
v7 legal reconciliation is independently recomputed
v9 temporal/replay coherence is independently recomputed
verified campaign still grants no execution, live value, finality or promotion authority
non_claims: a production ledger representation is connected
